description: This file defines a utility enum 'AsyncTimeout' with static methods to execute asynchronous operations with a timeout mechanism, supporting both seconds and milliseconds units. It uses Swift concurrency features such as async/await and task groups to implement the timeout logic.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a specified timeout in seconds, returning the result or throwing a timeout error.

methods.name: withTimeoutMs
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a timeout specified in milliseconds, internally converting it to seconds and calling 'withTimeout'.
